In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of TEM-188 in Algeria is the first report of this new ESBL.
the presence of the CTX-M-1, TEM-48, TEM-4, and TEM-188 genes in Algeria is of great concern.
TEM-48, CTX-M-3 (TEM-4), and CTX-M-14 (TEM-48) are the main ESBLs in Algeria, and CTX-M-type ESBLs are the most prevalent ESBLs in this country.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of CTX-M-1, CTX-M-2, CTX-M3 and TEM-1, TEM-4 and TEM-48 beta-lactamases was demonstrated in the isolates.
we have identified a new ESBL, TEM-188 in Algeria, and that the most common ESBLs in Algeria are CTX-M and TEM.
the presence of ESC-resistant Salmonella in Algeria is not a new phenomenon.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CTX-M-1 group is the predominant ESBL gene in Salmonella in Algeria, and that CTX-M-14 and CTX-M-27 have not been detected in this country.
